title: CppCon 2018: Stoyan Nikolov “OOP Is Dead, Long Live Data-oriented Design”
summary: A CppCon 2018 talk arguing that OOP has failed to deliver on reuse and performance, and presenting data-oriented design for C++ with practical worked examples from real systems.
why: HN cites it as a concrete, worked example of data-oriented design and as an alternative to OOP in performance-sensitive code.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
